question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Conscientous"** is incorrectly spelt and should be **"Conscientious"**. It means wishing to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly. (ईमानदार)

 
 
• **Example: **She is a **conscientious** worker who pays attention to details.
 
 
 
• **"Conscientious"** refers to a person who is diligent and careful in their work. (ईमानदार)
 
 
• **Example: **He was a **conscientious** student, always completing his assignments on time.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Apparent **(स्पष्ट): Clearly visible or understood; obvious.

 
 
• **Example:** The error was apparent to everyone who looked at the report.
 
 
 
• **Acknowledgement **(स्वीकृति): Acceptance of the truth or existence of something.
 
 
• **Example: **He gave an acknowledgment of her contribution to the project.
 
 
 
• **Fulfil **(पूरा करना): Achieve or realize something desired, promised, or predicted.
 
 
• **Example:** She hopes to fulfil her dreams of becoming a doctor.
